ordered_implementation.operation: Freeze annotation and boundary conventions before aligning detector
ordered_implementation.detail: Keep full source spans and independent reviewers answers. Parent adjudicates presence, linguistic finishedness, reference unresolved and scope separately. Annotation disagreement about maximal phrase vs anchor is explicitly unresolved until adjudication; never nearest-span labels or prediction-conditioned clipping.

ordered_implementation.operation: Add bounded DATE expression proposer on TRAIN inputs
ordered_implementation.detail: One token scanner plus finite expression recognizers; preserve offsets in original Python Unicode codepoints. Recognize day-number+month(+year), month+day-number/ordinal(+year), ordinal word(s)+of+month, lone ordinal/month only with a local date predicate or admissible question-role support; relative periods, business-day phrases, before/after expressions, ranges/alternatives, and open complements. No hardcoded case IDs, brief dates, test answers or fixed branch values.

ordered_implementation.operation: Join dependent tokens to expression span before completion features
ordered_implementation.detail: Keep qualifiers that change temporal reference inside the expression: nested before/after anchors, of-complements, date range endpoints, calendar modifiers. Retain open of/before/after/to/or tails and local truncated tokens even without ellipsis. Do not return inner tomorrow as full expression, or first date of an unfinished range as completed whole range. Atom spans may be sidecar children; one maximal expression is the classification unit.

ordered_implementation.operation: Use same feature extractor for actual-candidate fit, eval, scorer and export
ordered_implementation.detail: Freeze feature_version and window rules in bundle. Shared function consumes actual proposed expression span, clipped local clause context, clipping flags and admitted phase/question metadata. Reject wrong feature_version. Add numerical parity over both scores and eligibility; frozenv2 head is not silently reinterpreted with new features.

ordered_implementation.operation: Align to adjudicated TRAIN, then gate narrow CPU fit
ordered_implementation.detail: Run exact kind/start/end matching after source adjudication. Report misses and unmatched candidates. Recount fully reviewed canonical class groups on actual matched eligible spans, not authored counts or oracle spans. Fit only after20complete and20unfinished groups; same paired groups may support both classes. No encoder or GPU remedies regex/annotation/mask failures.

span_rules.unit: Maximal contiguous local temporal expression with determiners/internal complements, optional year and open operators; keep terminal truncation punctuation only when it belongs to that expression. Exclude unrelated final sentence punctuation, introducing payment verb and unrelated following clause. Leading on is outside a full expression but retained as the sole evidence of an open date complement when no content follows. This convention is a proposed annotation contract, not a retroactive redefinition of old scores.
span_rules.coordination: A range/alternative remains one candidate when syntactically linked (from A to B / either A or B). Separate same/sibling-target clauses remain separate; source correction edges retain direction. Ambiguous ownership produces boundary/scope mask, not whole-turn union.
span_rules.cross_clause: Do not broaden over hard semicolon/new sentence/sibling clause. If relation genuinely spans clauses, keep atom spans plus unsupported composite relation sidecar and mask the narrow binary classifier; old0161 cannot be recovered by swallowing its whole turn merely to match authored span.
span_rules.ambiguity: No currency/date canonical value inferred by this proposer. Date-like word May in a modal clause, standalone number, surname or identifier stays unsupported/competing unless local syntax supports a date. Question role is support, never permission to label every answer a date.
span_rules.limits: Input<=4096codepoints, <=16candidates and<=12localclauses; candidate<=512codepoints. Overflow abstains without truncating candidate list. Keep local clause IDs independent of128character source turnID.
span_rules.security: Preserve R3 security-field isolation and whole-turn lexical masking when trustworthy field separation unavailable. No source secret, DOB/token or sibling secret text in DATE features, including question text. Never treat security_date as payment_date.

local_feature_contract.pilot_choice: Retain R3 proposed48-codepoint each-side window for first bounded CPU experiment; no window sweep on exposedDEV. Candidate<=512; left/right end at local clause boundary. Version this explicit48 choice (earlier design allowed at most96).
local_feature_contract.feature_content: Use candidate surface, local word1/2 and bounded char3/4 features, open-operator/word-boundary/punctuation position, bounded left/right contextual tokens. Optional admitted phase/question role and exact prior-continuation flag only. No raw product/call/turn IDs, canonical values, gold boundary, source annotation, future text or whole-turn any-no/not bit.
local_feature_contract.clipping: Return left_clipped/right_clipped and dependency_incomplete. If deciding scope requires omitted predicate or multi-clause relation, mask/abstain instead of presuming completion. No implicit tail=true from window truncation; tail fields refer separately to expression, clause and delivered turn.
local_feature_contract.admissible_continuation: A fragment may use preceding expression only with independent original source event and matching opaque unresolved component token. Do not concatenate question text as spoken user evidence or invent a prior reference because the phase is date.
local_feature_contract.shared_entrypoint: date_features_v3_next(snapshot, actual_candidate, source_admission)->{features,eligible,reason,feature_version,window_bounds}; use identical implementation in table builder, CPU score, evaluation and json/re export. Do not change R3 functions in place; next version only.
local_feature_contract.training: One binary complete/unfinished head; 80epochs, L2=.0002, group->example->candidate averaging, fixed feature cap<=512 (384 acceptable predeclared). No ambiguous/unsupported/absent assigned a binary target. New head remains uncalibrated shadow; frozenv2 metrics unchanged.

amount_time_recipient_scope.amount_time: For later deterministic span parity, money candidate should retain explicit currency unit, and clock candidate its local time-zone/deictic modifier. Bare numeric anchors may remain sidecar atoms. Currency negation, loan-vs-card target mismatch and timezone reference remain separate. Do not train those heads to repair DATE readiness.
amount_time_recipient_scope.reference_mentions: Date/amount references such as its own date/the card amount and rejection of old day can be sidecar reference mentions, not literal normalized values. Missing resolver => unresolved_reference/abstain; no current-question default overriding explicit other target.
amount_time_recipient_scope.recipient: Recipient producer absent. Mark detector capability unsupported; do not force a generic regex name detector or pretend no_candidate establishes recipient absence. Receipt/identity assent cannot become financial consent.

bounded_scanner_outline: Tokenize original text with offsets; retain words, numbers, hyphens, slash, colon, apostrophes and ellipsis tokens. Mark identifier/clock/security spans first as competing types. Do not normalize text before recording offsets.

Within each local clause, seed DATE on MONTH, WEEKDAY, ORDINAL, numeric date separator pattern, temporal-noun phrase or DATE-question-supported open operator. MONTH/WEEKDAY alone are hypotheses, not verified dates; case and phase alone cannot prove validity.

Enumerate bounded token productions: [ORDINAL|DAYNUMBER] [of] MONTH [YEAR]; MONTH [ORDINAL|DAYNUMBER] [YEAR]; [WEEKDAY,] calendar-expression; determiner+ordinal+[business|working]+day+[of PERIOD]; relative-period; [number duration] [before|after] temporal-anchor; [from A to B|either A or B]. Permit missing final operand as an OPEN production; do not consume following unrelated predicate as that operand.

Extend to maximal temporal phrase only while a recognized production consumes tokens. Internal before/after/of/to/or creates a dependency; if it is syntactically unresolved or exceeds bounds retain OPEN/unsupported diagnostics. One optional nested relation level initially; deeper dependencies abstain rather than flatten to inner anchor.

Candidate span is the maximal expression. Child atom offsets retained only in sidecar for explanation. A parent candidate and its child are not two independent training examples. Tie/overlap with incompatible types or incompatible maximal parses => competing/boundary mask.

Emit raw spans, kind hypothesis, clause ID, proposer version and capability diagnostics. No exact date/money normalization or learned permission. Freeze scanner version before evaluating a model; changing candidate boundaries invalidates prior calibration even when head bytes stay equal.
